parameters.subject: Verfiy your email
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.fullName }}, 

Thank you for your enquiry. Please verify your email to allow us to process your enquiry. Please note this email with expire in 1 hour, after which your enquiry will be automatically deleted.

parameters.formDescription: Please complete this form to send your legal enquiry

values.fieldLabel: Which country if your enquiry from?

values.formSubmittedText: You will receive an email to verify your email. Please follow the steps in the email to ensure that your enquiry is processed. This link will expire in 1 hour. If your email is not verified, your enquiry will be deleted.

parameters.inputSchema:
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "areaOfLaw": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "Corporate & Commercial",
        "Intellectual Property",
        "Employment",
        "Tax & Banking",
        "Family",
        "Wills & Probate",
        "Property",
        "Personal Injury",
        "Immigration",
        "Civil Disputes",
        "Criminal",
        "Human Rights",
        "Environmental"
      ],
      "description": "The area of law that best matches the enquiry"
    }
  },
  "required": ["areaOfLaw"]
}

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.enquiryID }} - Thank you for your enquiry
parameters.html:
=Dear {{ $json.fullName }},

Your enquiry has been received and passed to our team. Your reference number is {{ $json.enquiryID }}.
